newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbekistan to export natural gas to Kazakhstan.
newsitem.headline: Uzbekistan to export natural gas to Kazakhstan.

text.p: Uzbekistan has promised neighbouring Kazakhstan one billion cubic metres of natural gas for 1997, a Kazakh diplomat said on Tuesday.

"The problem of Kazakhstan's debt of $26 million has been decided, and the government of Kazakhstan has given its guarantee to Uzbekistan," Karazhan Ablyazimov, a senior Kazakh diplomat based in the Uzbek capital Tashkent, told Reuters.
He gave no details of the agreement, signed in Tashkent on Monday between the Uzbek government and Kazakh Deputy Prime Minister Dyusembay Duiseinov.
Kazakhstan's Deputy Oil and Gas Minister, Anatoly Lobaev, said last week the republic would pay for Uzbek gas in kind with Kazakh products and transport of Uzbek goods through Kazakh territory.
Last week, many residents in the snow-covered Kazakh capital Almaty had to heat water on fires in the street after Uzbekistan cut gas supplies.
